hooks.command:
[ -f '.cc-forge/state.json' ] || exit 0; STAGE=$(python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('.cc-forge/state.json')); print(str(d.get('current_stage','?')) + ' ' + d.get('stage_name',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); NEXT=$(python3 -c "import json; tasks=json.load(open('.taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json')).get('tasks',[]); pending=[t for t in tasks if t.get('status') not in ['done','cancelled']]; t=pending[0] if pending else None; print('#' + str(t['id']) + ' — ' + t['title']) if t else print('all tasks complete')" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); DONE=$(python3 -c "import json; tasks=json.load(open('.taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json')).get('tasks',[]); print(len([t for t in tasks if t.get('status')=='done']))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); TOTAL=$(python3 -c "import json; tasks=json.load(open('.taskmaster/tasks/tasks.json')).get('tasks',[]); print(len(tasks))" 2>/dev/null || echo '?'); DATE=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d'); printf '
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  HERMES · CLARK · Stage %s
  %s
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
  Tasks:  %s/%s done
  Next:   %s
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
' "$STAGE" "$DATE" "$DONE" "$TOTAL" "$NEXT"
